gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: The match officials postponed the fixture because of the storm.
gaps.sentence: The fixture ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Postpone' = 'put off'; in the passive: the fixture was put off.

gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: A committee is looking into the sudden rise in food allergies.
gaps.sentence: The sudden rise in food allergies ___ a committee.
gaps.hint: phrasal verb in the progressive passive
gaps.explanation: 'A committee is looking into X' becomes the passive 'X is being looked into by a committee'.

gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.
